data.title: 椎名真由理 · 晴空下的向日葵冰棒之约
data.action: 双手捏着正在融化的双色苏打冰棒小心咬下一口，头戴宽檐草帽微微歪头，笑眼弯弯地向对方递出另一半，脚丫在温润白沙中轻轻踩弄
data.location: 避暑小岛的浅滩遮阳伞边
data.lighting: 明媚晴空侧逆光，沙滩金白反射与草帽下透射的柔光
data.description: 避暑海湾的上午阳光清澈透明。椎名真由理穿着天真雏菊荷叶边复古连体泳裙，头戴缀着天蓝丝带的宽檐草帽。她小心咬着苏打冰棒，将另一半朝你递来，笑盈盈地轻哼着‘嘟嘟噜’，海风拂过白沙与裙摆，满是无忧无虑的治愈气息。
data.promptProse: Standing barefoot in warm white sand beside a bright beach umbrella on a sunny resort island morning, Mayuri wears a retro pastel sky-blue swimdress sprinkled with tiny white daisies and topped with a ribboned wide-brim straw sunhat. Nibbling happily on one half of a melting soda popsicle, she tilts her head playfully while extending the other half toward the viewer with a beaming smile. Crisp morning sunlight glints across the clear shallows and filters softly through her hat brim.
data.animaCaption: Standing barefoot on white beach sand in her daisy-print sky-blue swimdress and wide-brim straw hat, Mayuri nibbles a soda popsicle while offering the other half toward the viewer with a cheerful smile. Bright morning sunlight shines across the clear sea.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a vintage pastel sky-blue one-piece swimdress patterned with tiny white daisies, layered ruffled hems, and a sweetheart neckline.
